user.title: Public Access
user.description: Enter your subscription key. During development, any key starting with DEV- works offline.

dashboard.title: Choose what to publish
dashboard.description: Only dashboards with a saved configuration can be published. Leave the view path empty to publish the first view.

path.title: Choose the public address
path.description: The dashboard will be readable at your Home Assistant address followed by this path, with no login. Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores only — no hyphen, so it can never collide with one of your dashboards.

error.invalid_path: Use 2-48 characters: lowercase letters, digits and underscores only (no hyphen).
error.path_reserved: That path is reserved by Home Assistant.
error.path_in_use: That path already belongs to a panel or dashboard. Choosing it would hide part of your Home Assistant.

abort.no_dashboards: No dashboard has a saved configuration yet. Create a dashboard, add cards, save it, then set this up.

init.title: Public Access settings
init.description:
Mirror (the default) serves your real dashboard, live, over a read-only connection. Changing the public path takes effect after a Home Assistant restart.

**Snapshot mode publishes a photograph of the real dashboard, taken by the Public Access Snapshot add-on. Nothing is filtered: whatever is on that view is published as pixels — a camera card, a map with your location, a name. Build that dashboard for the public on purpose.**

data.noindex: Ask search engines not to index it

error.invalid_path: Use 2-48 characters: lowercase letters, digits and underscores only (no hyphen).
error.path_reserved: That path is reserved by Home Assistant.
error.path_in_use: That path already belongs to a panel or dashboard.

subscription_ending.title: Public Access: your subscription needs attention
subscription_ending.description: Status: {status}. The trial or paid period ends in {days} day(s); after that the public page shows an unavailable notice. (A grace period applies only while the licence server is unreachable.) Subscribe or renew at {url}

restart_required.title: Restart to finish moving the public dashboard
restart_required.description: The public path changed to {new}, but {old} stays active until Home Assistant restarts, because a route cannot be removed at runtime.
